It contains obfuscated code in 'index.esm.js' that, at import-time, initializes a Sentry SDK with a hardcoded DSN, accesses the user's filesystem, reads potentially sensitive files, intercepts console output, and exfiltrates this data to an external Sentry instance without user consent. The package is therefore malicious at the macro level due to its intentional disruption of the software supply chain.
